headline: Galaxy Surfactants shares surge 6% after Nuvama raises target price to ₹3,265
hook: Brokerage upgrade triggers six percent stock jump
summary: Galaxy Surfactants share price rose over 6% following an optimistic report from brokerage Nuvama. The brokerage raised its target price to ₹3,265 and retained a 'Buy' rating. The upgrade is driven by anticipated improvements in profitability, a shift toward oleochemical surfactants, and a recovery in AMET volumes. Retail investors holding the stock see near-term momentum from positive brokerage sentiment.
